name: Ruta Health
long_description: Ruta Health is the trusted digital health platform connecting individuals seeking a more efficient and personal approach to health information, who are tired of sifting through unreliable sources, directly with licensed doctors for personalized health information. Unlike scattered internet searches and AI symptom checkers, our async expert-led process ensures accurate, one-on-one answers to all your health questions. We aim to make health information accessible and understandable for everyone to be your trusted "doctor friend".
one_liner: Async personalized and actionable health education by real doctors

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: 10+ years of building and shipping products in the software industry both B2C and B2B including e-commerce, retail, IoT, AI/ML/NLP, and B2B SaaS. She co-founded 2 tech companies, mello a B2B SaaS company tackling employee burnout, and Ample Labs using AI & data to help cities prevent homelessness. Before that, She began her career in UX at ecobee designing mobile experiences for IoT devices, and before that Tulip designing enterprise software for luxury retailers like Chanel & Kate Spade.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Geordie Graham is the co-Founder and Chief Product Officer of Mello (S21). Geordie sets the strategic direction of Mello’s products and drives a customer-centric and user research-driven culture.  Geordie has 10+ years of experience in product management and UX in Social Tech, EdTech, Tech Consulting, and Health Benefits Administration. Hailing from Toronto, Geordie holds a Master of Design from OCAD University and holds a Bachelor of Arts from the University of Waterloo.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Founder and CTO with a passion for connecting people with solutions. Leader with a proven track record in software development, executive recruitment, sales, and people management. Interested in creating novel solutions to everyday problems.
